read: They're primed for catharsis and want anthems they can own, not just borrow from a cheap playlist.

tracks.title: House of Jealous Lovers
tracks.why: To weaponize the raw, chaotic energy already present in this sweaty basement.
tracks.transition: Let the frantic cowbell and bassline ride out into a wall of feedback.

tracks.why: Converts the chaos into pure, arms-in-the-air, melodic indie euphoria everyone knows.
tracks.transition: Loop the final synth arpeggio, slowly filtering it into the Justice intro drums.

tracks.title: D.A.N.C.E.
tracks.why: The ultimate hands-up singalong, shifting the sound from guitars to iconic blog house.
tracks.transition: Let the kids' choir fade, blending its key into Antony's soaring opening vocal.

tracks.title: Blind
tracks.why: To bring a deeper, soulful, and legendary house groove to the floor.
tracks.transition: Quick echo out on the final vocal, then slam in the next track's sample.

tracks.title: Deceptacon
tracks.why: A shot of pure feminist punk energy to send the room into overdrive.
tracks.transition: Use a short, chaotic loop of the riff to build tension before the drop.

tracks.title: Standing in the Way of Control (Soulwax Nite Version)
tracks.why: The final, relentless, cathartic knockout that leaves nothing left in the tank.
tracks.transition: Let the pounding eight-minute techno-rock epic play out to its glorious, exhausting end.
